sources.title: About audience signals for Performance Max
sources.rights: metadata_reference_only; paraphrase only; no copied page body
sources.finding: Audience signals are suggestions; delivery can extend outside them.
sources.limitation: Does not establish a strict warm-only audience or the account's available controls.

sources.title: About enhanced conversions
sources.rights: metadata_reference_only; paraphrase only; no copied page body
sources.finding: First-party matching supports online measurement and, for leads, imported offline outcomes.
sources.limitation: Does not prove complete attribution, consent or a CG client's setup.

sources.title: Customer lifecycle audience setup
sources.rights: metadata_reference_only; paraphrase only; no copied page body
sources.finding: Customer lifecycle setup has campaign and list requirements that must be checked for the selected mode.
sources.limitation: Do not treat lifecycle-goal eligibility as a universal Customer Match rule.

sources.title: Measure your lifecycle goals campaigns
sources.rights: metadata_reference_only; paraphrase only; no copied page body
sources.finding: Lifecycle reporting requires the relevant goal and purchase conversions; customer classification can be uncertain. Conversion value adjustments differ from original value.
sources.limitation: Do not call adjusted bidding value verified sales, or infer first-ever customers from imperfect detection.

sources.title: About ad formats available in different campaign types
sources.rights: metadata_reference_only; paraphrase only; no copied page body
sources.finding: Text, image, video and Shopping formats serve different creative functions.
sources.limitation: The page is a format reference, not proof that every listed product is newly available in a given account.

sources.title: About Custom Audiences
sources.rights: metadata_reference_only; paraphrase only; no copied page body
sources.finding: Custom Audience use in an ad group requires at least 1,000 matched users.
sources.limitation: This threshold is specific to that use, not a minimum business following or a marketing permission.

sources.title: Spark Ads
sources.rights: metadata_reference_only; paraphrase only; no copied page body
sources.finding: Spark Ads can use organic brand posts or authorised creator posts.
sources.limitation: Do not infer music or creator rights. Ambiguous detailed specifications on the page were not used as rules.

sources.title: Smart+ upgraded experience
sources.rights: metadata_reference_only; paraphrase only; no copied page body
sources.finding: The upgraded Smart+ experience supports configurable automation and may not be available to every account.
sources.limitation: Confirm the actual account, regional availability and controls rather than infer rollout completion.

sources.title: Ways to manage your business chats on WhatsApp
sources.rights: metadata_reference_only; paraphrase only; no copied page body
sources.finding: The publication describes user control over business messages and pre-approved templates for business-initiated API messages.
sources.limitation: This is a messaging publication, not current Meta Ads eligibility or jurisdiction-specific legal advice.

candidates.title: Distinguish intended audience from actual delivery
candidates.principle: Keep relationship, intent and delivery mode separate.
candidates.limitation: Do not invent delivered audience composition from a creative label.

candidates.title: Performance Max signals are not strict audience boundaries
candidates.principle: Describe an audience signal as a suggestion.
candidates.limitation: Check actual campaign controls and do not imply exclusive reach.

candidates.title: Verify matched size before TikTok Custom Audience ad-group use
candidates.principle: Check the documented 1,000 matched-user requirement for this specific use.
candidates.limitation: A raw CRM count or social following is not matched eligible reach.

candidates.title: Obtain creator authorisation for Spark Ads
candidates.principle: Record the authorisation covering the chosen organic post.
candidates.limitation: Authorisation does not automatically establish all music or other rights.

candidates.title: Treat Smart+ availability as account-specific
candidates.principle: Record observed capability instead of assuming rollout.
candidates.limitation: Documentation presence does not prove enablement.

candidates.title: Do not apply Google lifecycle purchase reporting to non-purchase leads
candidates.principle: Keep purchase-only lifecycle metrics within their documented scope.
candidates.limitation: Use verified CRM outcomes for lead quality.

candidates.title: Separate adjusted conversion value from actual revenue
candidates.principle: Label bidding adjustments and original conversion values distinctly.
candidates.limitation: Neither is automatically reconciled accounting revenue.

candidates.title: Connect first-party lead outcomes without promising perfect attribution
candidates.principle: Plan offline lead outcome feedback through supported measurement.
candidates.limitation: Permission, identity matching and coverage must be verified.

candidates.title: Respect the separate messaging permission and suppression boundary
candidates.principle: Keep business messaging preferences separate from assumed ad-audience eligibility.
candidates.limitation: Current channel policies and applicable law require separate review.

candidates.title: Specify the proof to capture before the shoot
candidates.principle: Choose evidence shots from the decision obstacle in the brief.
candidates.limitation: A CG creative proposal, not a scientifically established universal performance rule.

candidates.title: Do not assume every customer is ready for an upsell
candidates.principle: Separate first purchase, repeat, lapsed and service-recovery needs.
candidates.limitation: Requires actual client evidence and consented communication.

candidates.title: Do not generalise one client observation into universal guidance
candidates.principle: Review scope, evidence design and uncertainty before reuse.
candidates.limitation: No actual campaign performance has been supplied to this candidate.

scenarios.name: Restaurant / hospitality
scenarios.outcome: Attended bookings or verified covers; contribution where known.
scenarios.limit: Directions and booking clicks do not prove visits. Menus, times and offers need current approval.
scenarios.shots: Real food, the intended occasion, service interaction, entrance and atmosphere.
scenarios.destination: Approved booking or enquiry path; directions only where that is the right action.

angles.cold: Show a first visit through a recognisable occasion, appetising real food and enough location context.
angles.warm: Answer one real hesitation about the menu, group experience or booking process, using evidence rather than hype.
angles.customer: Give regulars a genuine reason to return, such as a verified new item or event, without inventing loyalty mechanics.

scenarios.name: Physical retail
scenarios.outcome: Verified store transactions or visits where measured.
scenarios.limit: No invented price, stock, sizing, opening hours or online availability.
scenarios.shots: Product in use, fit and finish, meaningful details, store assistance and location cues.
scenarios.destination: The approved store, product enquiry or fitting path.

angles.cold: Demonstrate the product in a use case that makes a store visit worthwhile.
angles.warm: Show the fit, material, comparison or in-store assistance that resolves a buying question.
angles.customer: Introduce verified new arrivals or compatible additions, without claiming to know an anonymous viewer's purchases.

scenarios.name: Ecommerce
scenarios.outcome: Net orders, contribution, new-customer cost and observed repeat purchase.
scenarios.limit: Separate provider attribution from orders, refunds and contribution. Future value needs cohort evidence.
scenarios.shots: Product in use, dimensions or fit, close detail, packaging and authorised customer proof.
scenarios.destination: Matching product or collection page with accurate delivery and return information.

angles.cold: Show one concrete job the product performs and a clear demonstration of its difference.
angles.warm: Resolve the main product, fit, delivery or returns concern before repeating an offer.
angles.customer: Offer an appropriate replenishment, compatible add-on or useful bundle based on the actual purchase cycle.

scenarios.name: Local services
scenarios.outcome: Qualified enquiries, booked jobs and verified won value.
scenarios.limit: Call and WhatsApp button clicks are not qualified leads. Do not invent service areas or turnaround promises.
scenarios.shots: Real process, equipment, credible workmanship and the conditions needed for a quote.
scenarios.destination: An approved enquiry route that asks only useful qualification questions.

angles.cold: Make the service problem recognisable, then show the actual process and service-area relevance.
angles.warm: Explain what the quote covers and demonstrate competence against the prospect's specific objection.
angles.customer: Present a genuinely relevant maintenance or follow-on need at a sensible interval, not a default upsell.

scenarios.name: Professional / B2B
scenarios.outcome: Qualified opportunities, sales-stage progress and won contribution over the relevant cycle.
scenarios.limit: Do not substitute low cost per lead for pipeline value. Permission is required for client cases.
scenarios.shots: Expert explanation, real workflow, permissioned case evidence and clear process diagrams.
scenarios.destination: A focused enquiry or resource page aligned with the purchasing decision.

angles.cold: Name a specific operational problem and show a credible approach rather than a broad claim of expertise.
angles.warm: Address purchasing risk with a permissioned case, process explanation or carefully scoped demonstration.
angles.customer: Identify a real next business problem the service can address; avoid blanket cross-selling.

scenarios.name: Regulated / high-risk
scenarios.outcome: A correctly defined permitted business action, with sector review.
scenarios.limit: No sensitive-trait inference, unsupported medical/financial claims or guaranteed outcomes.
scenarios.shots: Accurate service context and reviewed explanatory material, without fabricated testimonials or results.
scenarios.destination: A reviewed information or enquiry route with appropriate limitations.

angles.cold: Explain the permitted service accurately without presuming a sensitive condition or personal attribute.
angles.warm: Provide reviewed evidence and limitations that help a person understand the service.
angles.customer: Use only appropriate, permissioned follow-up; separate service communication from promotion.
